name: Toaru Jukujo no Hentai Choukyou ~Oite nao Shitataru Himitsu to Etsuraku~
original_name: とある熟女の変態調教 ～老いてなお滴る秘蜜と悦楽～
source:
――The place I once was. The scenery I once saw.

A certain mansion. An exhilarating sight spread out before me. At that time, I couldn't understand it, but it was strongly and vividly etched into my mind.

White skin illuminated by dim light. The body adorned with ropes, patterns like blotches appearing on it.

――She was a beautiful person. A beautiful naked body. And then, a few weeks later. I suddenly had to leave this town. Without having time to understand what I had seen, I sealed the memory away and was swept away by the waves of a new life...

More than ten years have passed since then.

I was going to that mansion again. A woman's sobbing voice. The muffled voice could be heard coming from deep within the mansion. A strange sense of déjà vu captured my consciousness. This feeling, I’ve had a similar memory... somewhere... sometime...

“Ah... ah...”

The voice came from a hallway on the side. Behind the slightly opened sliding door, the owner of the voice... I tiptoed, as if drawn by the sound, heading toward it.
translation:
――我曾经呆过的地方。曾经看过的风景。

某宅邸。令人兴奋的景象展现在我面前。当时我无法理解，但它却强烈而生动地铭刻在我的脑海里。

皮肤白皙，在昏暗的灯光下显得格外美丽。身上饰有绳索，上面浮现出斑点般的图案。

——她是一个美丽的人。美丽的裸体。然后，几周后。我突然不得不离开这个小镇。还没来得及明白自己所看到的一切，我就将记忆封印起来，被新生命的浪潮卷走……

从那时起，已经过去十多年了。

我又要去那座豪宅了。女人抽泣的声音。低沉的声音从府邸深处传来。一种奇怪的似曾相识的感觉抓住了我的意识。这种感觉，我曾有过类似的记忆……在某个地方……某个时候……

“啊……啊……”

声音是从一旁的走廊里传来的。微开的拉门后面，是声音的主人……我仿佛被声音吸引，蹑手蹑脚地朝那里走去。
